operation.summary: Choose where your captures go, in any combination: memory, phone files, upload; and how long memory keeps them (within the owner's limits)

body.name: store
body.description: Any of memory, files, upload; [] = only return captures; null = back to the defaults (clips in memory, the rest only returned)

body.name: kinds
body.description: Only these kinds: camera, screen, mic, wakewords, sounds; null = all

body.name: upload_url
body.description: Where uploads go (POST, the capture as the body, X-Bridgit-Capture-Id/Kind/Agent/Captured-At headers). Tailnet always; public HTTPS when the owner allows internet callbacks. Needed with upload

body.name: upload_headers
body.description: Up to 8 extra headers for the upload, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}; never shown back

body.name: keep_minutes
body.description: How long memory keeps them, 1 to the owner's limit (default 10, owner limit 1440 unless changed)
